title: Artificial Cerebrospinal Fluid III (ACSF.III)
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
materials: Calcium Chloride, dihydrate (CaCl2·2 H2O) (Sigma C3881, Sigma C3306 or equivalent)
D-Glucose (C6H12O6; aka Dextrose) (Sigma G7021 or equivalent)
Magnesium Sulfate, Heptahydrate (MgSO4·7 H2O) (Sigma M1880 or equivalent)
Sodium Phosphate monobasic monohydrate (NaH2PO4 • H2O) (Sigma S9638 or equivalent)
Potassium Chloride (KCl) (Sigma P9333, Sigma P5405 or equivalent)
Picrotoxin (C30H34O13) (Abcam ab120315 preferred, Sigma P1675 or equivalent)
Kynurenic Acid (C10H7NO3) (Sigma K3375 preferred, Tocris 0223, or equivalent)
P200 pipette tips (Rainin GPL200F or equivalent)
Caution: Kynurenic acid is an irritant.
Warning: Personal Protective Equipment () should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.

steps.title: Prepare work area and PPE
steps.instruction: Wipe down powder‑hood surfaces with MilliQ water before and after use; wear double‑gloves, lab coat, sleeve protectors, safety glasses, face shield and a second pair of gloves; keep traffic to a minimum while handling toxic powders such as Picrotoxin.

steps.title: Prepare stock solutions
steps.instruction: Make all required stock solutions, label with name, date and initials, and store at room temperature (RT) for up to 60 days unless otherwise noted.

substeps.instruction: Calcium Chloride 200 mM: dissolve 29.4 g CaCl₂·2H₂O in 1 L MilliQ water; label “200 mM Calcium Chloride”.
Potassium‑Chloride/Phosphate/Magnesium 250 mM stock: prepare a solution containing 250 mM KCl, 125 mM NaH₂PO₄·H₂O, 100 mM MgSO₄·7H₂O (volumes/masses not specified).
Potassium Chloride “Super Stock” 50 mM: dissolve 18.6 g KCl in 1 L MilliQ water, add 17.3 g NaH₂PO₄·H₂O and 24.6 g MgSO₄·7H₂O; label “Super Stock”.
Sodium Chloride 4 M: dissolve 233.8 g NaCl in 1 L MilliQ water; label “4 M NaCl”.

steps.title: Measure water and start stirring
steps.instruction: Using a graduated cylinder, measure 500 mL MilliQ water and add it to an RNase‑free container containing an RNase‑free stir bar; place the container on a stir plate and set the speed to 7 or higher.

steps.title: Add stock solutions and solutes
steps.instruction: Add the following to the stirring water in the order listed, using sterile serological pipettes for liquids and a calibrated balance for solids:

substeps.instruction: 10 mL of the 250 mM KCl/125 mM NaH₂PO₄/100 mM MgSO₄ stock solution.
31.5 mL of the 4 M NaCl stock solution.
2.25 g D‑Glucose (weighed on a calibrated balance) – add slowly while stirring.
2.184 g Sodium Bicarbonate (NaHCO₃) – add slowly while stirring.

steps.title: Complete dissolution and adjust pH
steps.instruction: Continue stirring at high speed (setting 7 or higher) until all solids are fully dissolved; measure the pH with a calibrated meter and, if necessary, adjust to pH 7.3 using HCl or NaOH.

steps.title: Add calcium stock and set final volume
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL of the 200 mM Calcium Chloride stock solution, then bring the total volume to exactly 1000 mL with MilliQ water using a volumetric flask.

steps.title: Measure and correct osmolarity
steps.instruction: Measure osmolarity with the appropriate osmometer and adjust to the target range:

substeps.instruction: If using the Advanced Instruments 3250 Freezing‑Point Osmometer (PF0302), measure a 250 µL sample; target 300‑310 mOsm.
If using the OsmoTECH (PF0078), measure a 20 µL sample; target 300‑310 mOsm.
If using the Vapro 5600 (PF0284), measure a 10 µL sample; target 295‑305 mOsm.
If osmolarity is too high, add MilliQ water until the target range is reached.
If osmolarity is too low, add X mL of a 1 mg/mL NaCl solution, where X = volume (mL) required (as defined by the provided equation).
Re‑measure to confirm the osmolarity is within the specified range.

steps.title: Filter the ACSF solution
steps.instruction: Filter the prepared ACSF through a Corning 1 L 0.45 µm filter system using a Gast DOA‑P104‑AA vacuum pump and Tygon tubing:

substeps.instruction: Attach the filter system to the vacuum pump with Tygon tubing and turn the pump on.
Filter 500 mL of solution at a time while continuously stirring the remaining ACSF on the stir plate.

steps.title: Label, store and place final bottle
steps.instruction: Label the sterile final bottle with reagent name, preparation date, time and preparer’s initials; note that ACSF III expires one week from the preparation date; store the bottle at 4 °C and place it on a stir plate inside a fume hood.

steps.title: Add Picrotoxin and Kynurenic Acid (optional)
steps.instruction: After reviewing safety information for Picrotoxin and Kynurenic Acid, put on a face shield, sleeve protectors and a second pair of gloves; turn on the powder hood and let it run for 15 minutes before use:

substeps.instruction: Weigh 60 mg Picrotoxin in a fume hood and slowly add it to the stirring ACSF solution.
Weigh 189 mg Kynurenic Acid in a fume hood and slowly add it to the stirring solution.
Continue stirring until both compounds are fully dissolved (may take > 1 hour).

steps.title: Document preparation and clean up
steps.instruction: Record the preparation date, lot numbers of all components and final osmolarity in the online Laboratory Documentation form; then clean the work area:

substeps.instruction: Wash the stir bar with MilliQ water.
Clean the powder balance and wipe down all stir plates used.
Decontaminate all surfaces that contacted Picrotoxin with a 10 % bleach solution.
Wash hands thoroughly after handling Picrotoxin.
